notes: Andrew, 2026-11-10, with a screenshot of an Amazon listing (a camel chenille bench at the foot of a bed, on a pale gray-ivory rug that runs under the lower part of the bed): "I want an end of bed ottoman and a rug in the style here (i.e. coving a part of the end of the bed and the ottoman). Be mindful: radmanso drawers will be placed on the wall opposite the bed. show me layout in browser. Use amazon only for searches. Be a interior designer, make sure color,lenght etc work" Brief: an end-of-bed ottoman for the RÅDMANSÖ king (79 1/8" frame, 15 3/4" footboard): 2/3 to 3/4 of the frame (53 to 60"; his search was "bed bench king ottoman 60\""), 20" deep or less so the RÅDMANSÖ dresser opposite keeps 36" in front of its drawers (F-32), below the mattress line, a warm camel or cognac against the teal bedding and Sea Teal curtains (F-68 (9)), dark legs (F-68 (4)). THE PICK (1 of 3), staged in master-bedroom a, h and k: across the foot of the king, rot 90, x 69.625-87.625, y 39.8125-99.8125, centered and 2" off the footboard. 60" is 76% of the 79 1/8" frame, 9 9/16" in from each side; 18" deep leaves 50 3/4" to the dresser's fronts (F-32); 21" at the arms. Why: the RÅDMANSÖ is mid-century walnut, and this is a mid-century bench (flared arms, splayed dark wood legs), so the bench, bed and dresser speak one language; cognac is the warm note the teal room lacks (teal and cognac, near complements), a shade lighter than the walnut so it reads as its own piece; faux leather wipes clean after Maddie (4) and holds less dust than fabric (the family's dust concern, F-66; F-67 calls leather the low-dust choice); on its legs the rug shows under it. Same frame as the Olive (amazon-B0C88GSRJ1, 4.6 stars, 72 ratings) and the Sand (amazon-B0H5L2TCZT, whose bullets read: "Flip-up upholstered seat with safety hinges"). As read: $198.80 ("-10%", List Price $219.99), 5.0 stars (3 ratings on this color), FREE delivery Thursday, November 12, to Fresh Meadows 11365. The overview's Material row says 100% Polyester against the title's faux leather; the Sand's says 100% PU. Flags: fits.
